limitations: All responses are deterministic; no real-model reasoning, actual token bill or population performance estimate.
Batch CPU excludes startup; cumulative resource samples retain their separate wider scope.
V8 profiling, when requested, is diagnostic instrumentation; bundle regions are not source-map line proof.
Deterministic local provider; no task-reasoning or billing conclusion.

storage_guard_check.purpose: One-time kernel capacity check before product startup; not product disk usage.

campaign_target.pin_policy: Resolve GitHub stable and npm latest together before a campaign; pin version, release commit and package integrity for its duration. Historical bootstrap runs are excluded from current-release conclusions.
